richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Hyderabad

c: Gated communities in Hyderabad, from Gachibowli and Kondapur to Kompally, often plan an open-air gym as part of the clubhouse grounds. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to gated communities, IT campuses, schools, colleges and parks under the Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 630 km away, and come to Telangana by road.

The first decision for most communities is whether to buy one multi gym frame or a row of single machines. A multi gym is compact and easy to light, while single machines can be spread along a jogging track. Many sites use both. Our installation team or a dealer in south India fixes each one, grouted or self-standing. Share your site plan with the jogging track marked, and we will suggest a mix on a layout drawing.

items.q: Should a gated community choose a multi gym or single machines?
items.a: A multi gym saves space and keeps the gym in one place. Single machines spread along a track get used by walkers and runners. Many communities in Hyderabad choose a mix of both.

items.q: Do you supply IT campuses in Hyderabad?
items.a: Yes. We supply office campuses as well as residential communities. Send us the campus plan and photos, and we will mark the gym area on a layout drawing.
Our own installation team or a dealer in south India. They follow the approved layout drawing and fix each machine on a grouted or self-standing base.
